result.instructions: Tools for Sello, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders in Sello are paid but not yet delivered?"; "Show the rows of order 13901393 and who bought them."; "Which products are low on stock in Sello?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sello data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sello_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sello_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sello_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sello_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sello_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the Sello account: company, country, currency and invoice status. GET /account.

tools.name: sello_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List recent orders with a limited set of fields (customer, status, total, paid/delivered flags). Use `sello_get_order` for rows. Optional local filter by `status_id`. GET /orders.

limit.description: Return at most this many items (default 50). Sello returns up to 300 orders or 100 products per call.

status_id.description: Keep only orders with this status id (filtered after the call).

tools.name: sello_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order with all fields. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: sello_list_order_rows
tools.title: List order rows
tools.description: List the rows (products, quantity, price, tax) of one order. GET /orders/{id}/rows.

tools.name: sello_list_order_deliveries
tools.title: List order deliveries
tools.description: List the deliveries (tracking) of one order. GET /orders/{id}/deliveries.

tools.name: sello_get_order_history
tools.title: Get order history
tools.description: Show the change history of one order, 10 items per call. GET /orders/{id}/history.

next.description: Token from a previous call's `next` to fetch older history items.

tools.name: sello_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with a limited set of fields (name, SKU, stock, prices per integration). Use `sello_get_product` for all fields. GET /products.

limit.description: Return at most this many items (default 50). Sello returns up to 300 orders or 100 products per call.

tools.name: sello_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product with all fields, by Sello id or by your SKU (private reference). Give exactly one. GET /products/{id} or /products/sku/{sku}.

tools.name: sello_get_product_history
tools.title: Get product history
tools.description: Show the change history of one product, 20 items per call. GET /products/{id}/history.

next.description: Token from a previous call's `next` to fetch older history items.

tools.name: sello_list_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: List your order statuses (title, paid/delivered flags). Use the ids with `sello_update_order`. GET /status.

tools.name: sello_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List your suppliers. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: sello_list_integrations
tools.title: List integrations
tools.description: List the marketplace and webshop integrations connected to the account (status, market, last order check). Tokens are removed. GET /integrations.

tools.name: sello_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List the last 100 marketplace sync messages (errors, warnings). Sello deletes them after 14 days. GET /messages.

tools.name: sello_count_unread_messages
tools.title: Count unread messages
tools.description: Count unread sync messages. GET /messages/count.

tools.name: sello_get_stats_summary
tools.title: Get stats summary
tools.description: Show the sales summary of the account. GET /account/stats.

tools.name: sello_get_daily_turnover
tools.title: Get daily turnover
tools.description: Show turnover per day for the past 30 days, per integration id. GET /account/stats/turnover/daily.

tools.name: sello_get_monthly_turnover
tools.title: Get monthly turnover
tools.description: Show turnover per month, per integration id. GET /account/stats/turnover/monthly.

tools.name: sello_get_stock_worth
tools.title: Get stock worth
tools.description: Show the worth of the stock. GET /account/stats/stockworth.

tools.name: sello_get_top_sellers
tools.title: Get top sellers
tools.description: Show the best selling products. GET /account/stats/topsellers.

tools.name: sello_update_order
tools.title: Update order
tools.description: WRITE: change an order's status, notes or new-flag. Send only the fields to change. Get status ids from `sello_list_statuses`. A status change can trigger Sello automations (mail, stock). PUT /orders/{id}.

notes.description: New order notes (replaces the old notes).

is_new.description: Set or clear the new-order flag.

tools.name: sello_update_product_quantity
tools.title: Update product stock
tools.description: WRITE: set the stock quantity of one product by Sello id or by your SKU (give exactly one). Sello then syncs the new quantity to all active marketplaces. PUT /products/{id} or /products/sku/{sku}.

quantity.description: New stock quantity (absolute, not a change).

prompts.title: Get started with Sello
